0022600192.text: The Wizards (4-5, 2-3 on the road, 1.5 games back in second in the Southeast and 8th in the East) head to Oklahoma City on a two-game losing streak to face the Thunder (6-2, 4-0 at home, 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West), who are riding a two-game winning streak. Washington is missing Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Wizards lost their 2025-26 season series 0-2, most recently a 132-111 defeat in Washington on March 21, 2026.
